reason: I've never heard of this store, and nothing here says the lights are UL listed or that an electrician can install them without trouble. I buy lighting from Wayfair, Amazon or Lowe's because I know how delivery and returns work there.
objection: Is it UL listed and safe, and will my electrician install it? An unknown store with 10 to 12 business day delivery, 6 weeks for made-to-order, and return shipping on me if I change my mind is a lot to risk on a fixture I can't easily send back.
would_change_my_mind: Proof the fixtures are UL or ETL listed, shown on the product page, plus free returns or a store I already trust selling the same piece.
